title: C6 Pack Manifest
description: Language-neutral manifest for an Atlas pack artifact (architecture-spec section 3 contract 6; V3-PACK-FR-001..003). The manifest is the signed, integrity-bearing header of a pack: identity, SemVer version, engine-compat range, per-section content digests, and a signature block. It is producer-language-agnostic: a Python-extracted (DIS) pack and a TS-authored (Cortex) pack emit the same manifest shape. Field names are snake_case by convention (matching the DIS mapping_rules and the funnel stage shape); a TS producer normalizes camelCase to snake_case at serialization.

id.description: Pack identifier, lowercase kebab-case (for example retail or insurance-cac).

version.description: Pack version, SemVer (V3-PACK-FR-002). Distinct from the DIS mapping_version_id and the version int inside mapping_rules; see README versioning note.

engine_compat.description: SemVer range of engines this pack is compatible with (V3-PACK-FR-003). The exact range grammar is enforced by the loader's semver library; this pattern only guards the character set.

vertical.description: Optional vertical tag (for example retail, insurance).

content_digests.description: Per-payload-section SHA-256 over the canonicalized section bytes (JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8). Keys are payload section names; the loader recomputes and compares before use.

signature.description: Signature block. Scheme is cosign over the artifact bytes; the v0 key type is a KMS key-pair (V3-PACK-FR-003). This contract RECORDS the scheme; it does not implement signing. At skeleton stage signed is false and key_ref/value are null.

key_ref.description: KMS key resource reference used to sign; null until signed.

value.description: Detached signature (base64) over the artifact bytes; null until signed.
